subject: Sweep results + decision on launch review scope
body:
Team,

Sweep retro and decisions:

The full-scale run confirmed the slice results: +1.9% recall@10 over PCA baseline at full corpus scale, and the enlarged covariance batches held the LISSA noise down as Wei predicted. Cost came in under the reserved envelope.

Decisions:
1. Launch review on 8/6 covers the retrieval integration only. The RL-flavored applications (Puddle World-style successor features) stay research-track - interesting, not a product this half.
2. Nikhil owns the integration runbook for the retrieval serving team; Gustavo pairs on the snapshot-reader path since Corpus v2 cutover is now behind us.
3. Kaia to finalize the eval methodology doc - the recall@10 methodology got questions from Tomas's team and I want that airtight before LRB.

Great execution on a genuinely gnarly estimator.

Anders
